# [CS071] Duplicated Function Body (code-duplication)

Function bodies of at least metrics.min_duplicate_loc lines are identical.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | LOW |
| **Category** | Code Metrics |
| **CWE** | - |
| **OWASP** | - |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Copied code drifts: a fix applied to one copy, often a security fix, is missed in the others. Extract the shared body.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
func (a *Admin) audit(ev Event) { /* 15 lines */ }
func (u *User) audit(ev Event)  { /* the same 15 lines */ }
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
func audit(log Logger, ev Event) { /* 15 lines, once */ }
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [code-duplication]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    code-duplication: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore code-duplication -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** code-duplication
```
